race.comment: ASTON VALHALLA (8) has a strong record this track and trip including three wins from four starts. Recorded a nose win (22.02) in a Grade 5 last time at Ballarat. Rates on top and should go close. GOT A RUSTLER (7) was big odds last time but gave a huge sight after a fast early split, grabbed late but holding on to a placing when a 4.5 lengths third (22.28) over 390m at this track. Leading player again. FLUENT ACTION (1) comes off a (23.90) win last time, scoring by one length in a Grade 5 over 425m at Bendigo. Has already won five times from this draw. Looks suited here and can measure up. GOT A STAGE (2) finished in the placings last start and deserves some thought.
